id: s1 stale geometry: /info after the event
reason: a trade-off, not a fix: production died on the read above, and the restart that follows happens to load the re-converted metadata.bin, so it now reports the new size (192x128); the fork stays up, so it keeps the tile step and size it read when it first saw the dataset and still reports 216x144 until the CDN is restarted. id: s1 stale geometry: full read after the event
reason: the same trade-off: production, restarted by its crash, reads the tiles at the new 64-pixel step; the fork still reads them at the old 72-pixel step until the CDN is restarted, so tile content sits at the old positions and the 1088 voxels past tile (1,0,0)'s edge read as 0. The body is the same on both (compared under the same id without ', headers')
